title: EFF explains how to limit Siri AI’s access to app data in iOS 27
friendlyTitle: You can choose which apps the new Siri is allowed to search
summary: EFF documents how the new Siri can search content from Messages, Notes, Mail and supported third-party apps, sometimes using Apple’s Private Cloud Compute. Its guide shows users how to disable content indexing for selected apps and reviews the separate controls for app access and on-screen awareness.
friendlySummary: The new Siri can look through information in Apple apps and some other apps. EFF explains where to turn off access for apps that contain private information.
whyItMatters: More useful assistants need broader access to personal context. iPhone users should review sensitive apps individually rather than treating Siri as one all-or-nothing setting, especially where health, financial, legal or encrypted communications are involved.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A smarter assistant may see more of your personal data. Check each sensitive app and block access when the convenience is not worth the privacy risk.
